$comment: Manifest of every verse key and hadith reference the project cites, by chapter. scripts/fetch-quran.ts extracts exactly these ayat from the pinned Tanzil file. References only: no scripture text belongs in this file.

ch00.$comment: The imperative kun ('Be'): second-to-last whitespace-separated word of the Tanzil text of 36:82. build-calligraphy.ts extracts it from data/quran.json and asserts its base letters are U+0643 U+0646; never type it.

ch10.$comment: Five words of 21:104, 'as We began the first creation, We will repeat it': the twelfth whitespace-separated word from the end of the Tanzil text and the four after it. build-calligraphy.ts extracts them from data/quran.json and asserts their base letters; never type them.

analysis.$comment: Letter analyses (docs/SPEC.md, Chapter 7). Word positions count whitespace tokens that contain at least one base letter (Tanzil writes some pause marks as tokens of their own). scripts/build-analysis.ts derives public/assets/analysis/<id>.json from data/quran.json; never type the letters.
